objective: Check the product catalogue for the DeWalt Corded Angle Grinder (DCG 2BH-302 line) to verify if it has both disc diameter 180 mm and disc diameter 150 mm as claimed.

params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants where brand='DeWalt' and product_family_id in (select product_family_id from product_families where brand='DeWalt' and product_family_name like '%DCG 2BH-302%') and product_name like '%Corded Angle Grinder%'; then verify product_variant_properties for disc diameter 180 mm and power 2200 W to confirm base product; then check for disc diameter 150 mm property.

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Checked product {sku}: extra claim absent, answer <NO> with SKU {sku}
